title: Q-CLEANROOM-definition: a new system does not bring up definition on its own
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** cleanroom run, daily
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation cleanroom --probe definition
**Status:** closed

CLEANROOM-1: a sandbox built from nothing but seed/ and an idea did not bring up `definition` (the booted seed still meets its own definition (SYSTEM-SPEC-1: scripts/system.py --check against autonomy/system.json): SYSTEM.md is current, every clause's probe passes and every standing rule has its enforcement) with zero human steps.

Evidence (2026-11-27T11:43:17Z): SYSTEM.md is stale: run python3 scripts/system.py --write 

Paths: seed/, doctrine/cleanroom.json, foundation/cleanroom.py.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation cleanroom --probe definition passes

**Vacuous:** 2026-11-27T11:52:37Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-27T11:53:58Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 7.9 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
